text:
celia: Heads up  Were getting SCIM deprovision spikes and KMS decrypt header errors after the nightly key alias swap. Some tenants in ap-southeast show missing audit entries too. Anyone available?

kartik: Oncall. Sample error from provisioner: 
```
2026-04-10T04:12:10Z provisioner ERROR tenant=aurora scim=deprov kms_err=EnvelopeHeaderMismatch expected_kid=key/old-3 got=key/new-7
2026-04-10T04:12:10Z audit WARN tenant=aurora missing_audit_row action=deprovision actor=svc-scim
```

miriam: Did we run the envelope rewrap before rotating the alias? Thats required for cached envelopes in redis/s3.

celia: We planned rewrap but the job failed during the maintenance window (lambda timeout). Alias swap completed.

kartik: OK. Quick mitigations: 1) flip SCIM to "deferred mode" so it enqueues events instead of executing deprovs; 2) pause any automated RBAC prune jobs that could map NameID changes into deprovs; 3) retry rewrap with increased lambda timeout and smaller concurrency.

miriam: Also open a compliance ticket for audit backfill. We must not lose evidence. Backfilled rows should be labeled with origin=incident-1819999000.

devsec-bot: ALERT scim-deprov-spike severity=high tenants=9 events=198 incident=INC-2026-121 created_by=devsec-bot

celia: I flipped deferred mode for ap-southeast. Queue length rising but no destructive actions.

kartik: Rewrap plan: snapshot keys to s3://secure/envelopes/1819999000/, run rewrap lambda with 15m timeout, concurrency=4, format-detect (v1/v2 envelopes). Will stream progress to incident.

miriam: Also check if recent RBAC PR changed the SAML NameID->SCIM identity mapping. That could cause lookups to miss and trigger deprovs even if envelopes decrypt fine.

kartik: Good point. Ill diff the latest RBAC mapping and confirm. If mapping changed, we can add a transient lookup shim to accept legacy email nameids for 48h.

celia: Rewrap dry run: 12/12 sample rewrapped OK. Starting tenant batches now.

miriam: Keep the audit team in the loop for backfill approval. Do not write forged timestamps; annotate entries with "backfilled_due_kms" and include original_event_blob.

devsec-bot: NOTE incident INC-2026-121 state=mitigating owners=[celia,kartik,miriam] sla=72h

kartik: First batch done: rewrapped=150/1200. No further envelope decrypt errors for those tenants.

celia: After rewrap and shim, SCIM noise dropped ~98%. I'll prepare customer messaging draft after a full backfill estimate.

miriam: Good work. Postmortem items: improve rewrap job reliability, pre-rotation checklist (snapshot+test+maintenance-mode), and RBAC change gating when KMS or IdP changes overlap.

celia: Agreed. Posting logs to INC-2026-121 and will follow up with a postmortem doc.
